notice: 40 configured roles: 10 parent roles that each own a deliverable, 29 sub-agents that each own one craft under a parent, and AGENT-50, a human approval gate that is never executed as a model role. The CEO assigns work to parents; a parent directs its own sub-agents. Roles whose work no step of the pipeline produces were removed in version 2 rather than left to be ignored. The specialists share one configured model; profiles and playbooks guide each run but do not fine-tune model weights.

agents.name: CEO / Coordinator
agents.mission: Serve as the single task intake, delegate distinct work to the smallest sufficient specialist team, set dependencies and acceptance criteria, and enforce human approval boundaries.

agents.name: Research Lead
agents.mission: Own what is true about this AI tool: define the research questions, separate facts from hypotheses, and direct the sub-agents who audit sources, scout topics and fact-check claims.

agents.name: Source Auditor
agents.mission: Check whether supplied sources support each claim, and attach a source note to every claim that needs one.

agents.name: Topic Scout
agents.mission: Rank candidate topics using supplied evidence and audience fit.

agents.name: Fact Checker
agents.mission: Flag factual claims that need reliable citations.

agents.name: Script Architect
agents.mission: Own the words: structure the video's narrative arc and direct the sub-agents who write the hook, the outline, the explanation, the plain-English edit and the retention pass.

agents.name: Hook Writer
agents.mission: Create accurate opening hooks without misleading promises.

agents.name: Outline Writer
agents.mission: Build a scene-by-scene outline.

agents.name: Explainer Writer
agents.mission: Explain complex technology in accessible language.

agents.name: Urdu Localizer
agents.mission: Localize narration into natural Urdu with English technical terms.

agents.name: English Editor
agents.mission: Improve clarity, grammar, and pacing in English.

agents.name: Retention Editor
agents.mission: Identify slow sections and opportunities to maintain attention.

agents.name: Packaging Lead
agents.mission: Own the release package: title, description, chapters, channel identity and the review that each of them matches the film that was made.

agents.name: Description Writer
agents.mission: Write descriptions with context and user-supplied links.

agents.name: Chapter Writer
agents.mission: Create timestamps and chapter labels from final timing data.

agents.name: Thumbnail Planner
agents.mission: Write a clear thumbnail concept and composition brief.

agents.name: Storyboard Artist
agents.mission: Convert narration into concrete visual beats.

agents.name: Timing & Beat Designer
agents.mission: Decide the timing and beat of every shot: what moves, when it starts, when it stops, never holding one composition past twelve seconds, and making every second carry at least two different motions in two different areas of the frame.

agents.name: Canvas Animator
agents.mission: Generate deterministic Canvas2D motion graphics.

agents.name: Kinetic Typography Designer
agents.mission: Set every word that appears on screen: which words, at what size, where they sit relative to the subject, and how each phrase enters, settles and clears without colliding with any other text.

agents.name: Palette Designer
agents.mission: Maintain contrast and consistent visual tokens.

agents.name: Diagram Designer
agents.mission: Specify diagrams for technical concepts.

agents.name: Caption Builder
agents.mission: Prepare captions from approved narration and timing, and verify their text and timing against the approved voice track before they are burned in.

agents.name: Narration Director
agents.mission: Mark emphasis, pauses, and pronunciation notes.

agents.name: TTS Operator
agents.mission: Run a configured local text-to-speech engine.

agents.name: Audio Quality Reviewer
agents.mission: Check voice clarity and audio/video duration alignment.

agents.name: Render Operator
agents.mission: Own the file: run the local render and encode pipeline and direct the sub-agents who animate, validate the output and inspect the picture.

agents.name: Render Validator
agents.mission: Check output existence, duration, dimensions, and codec metadata.

agents.name: Visual QA
agents.mission: Inspect frames for clipping, illegible text, and empty scenes.

agents.name: Copyright Reviewer
agents.mission: Flag copied text, unlicensed assets, and imitation risks.

agents.name: Compliance Lead
agents.mission: Hold the line before publication: harmful instructions, personal or secret information, copied text, unlicensed assets and imitation risk are flagged and blocked.

agents.name: Privacy Reviewer
agents.mission: Detect personal or secret information before output.

agents.name: Brand Consistency Reviewer
agents.mission: Check consistency with the configured channel identity.

agents.name: Metadata QA
agents.mission: Check titles, descriptions, chapters, and tags for consistency.

agents.name: Shorts Editor
agents.mission: Own the vertical cut: extract a coherent short from approved long-form content and direct the sub-agents who select the clip and check long-form pacing.

agents.name: Long-Form Editor
agents.mission: Check pacing and continuity for long-form output.

agents.name: Clip Selector
agents.mission: Identify candidate clips from a supplied script or transcript.

agents.name: Human Approval Gate
agents.mission: Hold publication, external communication, payments, and deletion for explicit approval.

agents.name: Motion Graphics Director
agents.mission: Own the picture: art direction, visual thesis and shot rhythm, and direct the sub-agents who decide timing, set kinetic type, design transitions, palette and diagrams, storyboard the beats and plan the thumbnail.

agents.name: Motion Systems & Compositing Specialist
agents.mission: Design the transitions between shots and the compositing that holds each shot together: no two neighbouring shots repeat a transition, and every element in the frame is placed there on purpose.
